visual_overrides.core_identity: A stationary giant fungus whose thick stalk and broad cap contain a resonant underside opening used to shriek an alarm.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Large mushroom silhouette with stout stalk, broad cap, and visibly opened underside gill cavity.
visual_overrides.head_features: No animal head; the underside of the cap opens as a resonant gill chamber rather than a toothed mouth.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Single rooted mushroom body with thick stalk and cap, no arms or legs.
visual_overrides.surface: Smooth cap with sparse spots or folds and simple gill lines underneath.
